props.gloss_en: on the sixth of the month [Sivan] the Ten Commandments were given to Israel
R' Yosei: on the seventh of it
Rava: all agree that they came to the Sinai desert on Rosh Chodesh
and all agree that the Torah was given to Israel on Shabbat
R' Yosei: the month [Sivan] was fixed on Sunday, and on Sunday nothing was said to them because of the weariness of the journey
R' Yosei: on Monday He said to them 'and you shall be to Me a kingdom of priests' (Ex 19:6)
R' Yosei: on Tuesday He told them the mitzva of setting bounds
R' Yosei: on Wednesday they separated [husbands from wives]
the Rabbanan: the month was fixed on Monday, and on Monday nothing was said to them because of the weariness of the journey
the Rabbanan: on Tuesday He said to them 'and you shall be to Me'
the Rabbanan: on Wednesday He told them the mitzva of setting bounds
the Rabbanan: on Thursday they separated
the verse: 'sanctify them today and tomorrow' (Ex 19:10) -- two days of preparation
Moses added one day of his own accord
the baraita: three things Moses did of his own accord, and the Holy One agreed with him
the baraita: he separated from his wife
the baraita: he broke the tablets
the Holy One agreed with him about the added day
the Holy One agreed with him about the separation from his wife
the Holy One agreed with him about the breaking of the tablets
the Shechina did not rest [on Sinai] until Shabbat morning
'go say to them: return to your tents', and after it 'and you, stand here with Me' (Deuteronomy 5)
and some say: 'mouth to mouth I speak with him' (Num 12:8)
Reish Lakish: 'which you broke' (Ex 34:1) -- asher: may your strength be firm, that you broke [them]
the verse: 'and be ready for the third day' (Ex 19:11)
the baraita: 'third' -- the third of the month and the third [day] of the week (so the month began on Sunday)
whose is it? -- R' Yosei's
[for the Rabbanan] 'the third' -- to what? to the matter that is taught [in the baraita on Ex 19:8-9]
what the Holy One said to Moses, Moses to Israel, Israel to Moses, and Moses reported back -- this is the mitzva of setting bounds; the words of R' Yosei b. R' Yehuda
Rebbi: first he explained its punishment, and in the end its reward
Rebbi's derasha: vayashev -- words that shatter a person's mind; vayaged -- words that draw a person's heart like aggada
and some say: first he explained its reward, and in the end its punishment
the איכא דאמרי derasha: vayashev -- words that restore a person's mind; vayaged -- words as hard to a person as wormwood
the baraita: 'sixth' -- the sixth of the month, the sixth [day] of the week (so the month began on Sunday)
this too is R' Yosei's
Rava: [for the Rabbanan] the sixth -- of their encampment
Rav Acha bar Yaakov: the sixth -- of their journey
Rav: 'as the Lord your God commanded you' (the Shabbat commandment, Deuteronomy 5) -- commanded you at Mara
at Mara they were commanded about the Shabbat boundaries too (one master); the other: about Shabbat, not about boundaries
the baraita: in the Nisan of the Exodus they slaughtered on the 14th, left on the 15th, the firstborn were struck [the stam emends לערב to מבערב: the eve before], and that day was Thursday
[the Rabbanan:] Iyar of that year was made full [thirty days]
the baraita: Nisan was full and Iyar fell on Shabbat; Iyar was deficient and Sivan fell on Sunday
whose is it? -- R' Yosei's

Rav Pappa: they came [to the wilderness of Sin] on the 15th of the second month (Ex 16:1), and that day was Shabbat -- 'in the morning you shall see the glory of the Lord' (16:7) and 'six days you shall gather it' (16:26)

the tanna: the day the Mishkan was raised (1 Nisan, Ex 40:17) took ten crowns -- first of the Creation [Sunday], first for the princes, the priesthood, the service, the descent of fire, the eating of sacred food, the dwelling of the Shechina, the blessing of Israel, the ban on private altars, and first of the months
Acherim: between one Atzeret and the next, and one Rosh HaShana and the next, there are only four days [of the week]; in a leap year, five
Seder Olam: in the Nisan of the Exodus they slaughtered on the 14th, left on the 15th, and that day was Shabbat eve
whose is it? -- the Rabbanan's

R' Yosei: on the 2nd [of Sivan] Moses ascended and descended, on the 3rd ascended and descended, [as the stam emends the 4th: ומאחר שלא עלה מהיכן ירד? אלא] on the 4th ascended and descended, on the 5th built an altar and offered on it, on the 6th he had no leisure
the Galilean, before Rav Chisda: blessed is the Merciful who gave a threefold Torah, to a threefold people, by a third-born, on the third day, in the third month
whose view is it? -- the Rabbanan's
